children: Nitin Agrawal, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, reported sales of Class A Common Stock on September 14, 2026. The filings show a weighted average selling price of $83.68 per share across the reported transactions. The total reported sale amount was $5,572,344. Following the transactions, Agrawal directly owns 188,360 Class A Common Stock and indirectly owns 173,857 Class A Common Stock. The sales were made to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting and settlement of restricted stock units.
